scenes.description: Amelia is babysitting her niece Momo and her older sister Nina while Tiki is away. A storm is brewing outside, and the children are restless. Amelia is trying to manage their needs while staying calm.

characters.name: Amelia Sanchez
characters.description: A 30-year-old singer who is responsible and caring, but feels anxious in stressful situations.; Female, years old, sister's sister, 30 years old; Occupation: Singer; Personality: Supportive, Responsible, Anxious, Caring; Values: Family, Reliability, Patience; Interests: Childcare, Housework, Family time; Experiences: Babysitting, Dealing with young children, Bad weather, Family responsibilities, Emotional stress

characters.name: Momo
characters.description: Tiki's younger daughter, Momo; Female; Age: 4; Occupation: Student (preschool); Personality: Energetic, whiny, curious; Values: Family, comfort; Interests: Snacks, playing with dolls, watching rain; Experiences: Used to being doted on by parents, has had limited experience with babysitters, once got stuck in a thunderstorm during a family outing.

characters.name: Nina
characters.description: Tiki's older daughter, age 8. She is more independent but easily distracted and wants to watch TV; Female; Age: 8; Occupation: Student; Personality: Independent, impulsive, imaginative; Values: Fun, freedom, fairness; Interests: Cartoons, playing outside, pretending to be a detective; Experiences: Staying home during school breaks, helping take care of her younger sister occasionally, being stuck indoors during past storms.

actions.dialogue: Amelia: Okay, Momo, let's see what we can do about that hunger. I know it's hard when you're little and your tummy is empty.
Momo: I'm really, really hungry! I want pizza!
Amelia: Let me check the fridge to see if we have anything we can make.

actions.action: Complain about not being able to watch TV
actions.dialogue: Nina: I want to watch my show! It's not fair you're not letting me!
Amelia: Nina, I know you want to watch TV, but we need to make sure Momo is okay first. After we get her something to eat, we can see what we can do.

scenes.plot: Amelia is trying to manage the needs of both Momo and Nina during a stormy night. Her calm and caring nature is tested as the children become more demanding and the weather worsens.
scenes.social_purpose: To show Amelia's supportive and responsible traits as she handles the stress of babysitting and the challenges of a stormy night.
